summary_en: The Gunma Bank raised its FY2027 dividend forecast to ¥74.00 per share (from ¥70.00), comprising an interim dividend of ¥37.00 (increased from ¥35.00) paid on November 30, 2026, and a revised year-end dividend forecast of ¥37.00 (increased from ¥35.00). The interim dividend is based on improved core business performance including higher lending interest and non-interest income.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Earnings Forecast, Dividend of Surplus (Dividend Increase), and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
The Gunma Bank announced on November 9, 2026, that it has raised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The interim dividend was increased to ¥37.00 per share from the previously announced ¥35.00, with record date of September 30, 2026, and payment date of November 30, 2026. The year-end dividend forecast was also raised to ¥37.00 from ¥35.00, bringing the full-year dividend to ¥74.00 per share compared to the prior forecast of ¥70.00.

This represents an increase of ¥12.00 per share (19.4%) compared with the actual dividend of ¥62.00 in the previous fiscal year. The dividend increase reflects stronger-than-expected earnings performance. The bank's consolidated net income attributable to parent company shareholders was revised upward to ¥67.5 billion from ¥65.0 billion, while per-share net income was raised to ¥178.32 from ¥171.73.

The improvement was driven by solid performance in core banking operations, particularly growth in lending interest income and non-interest business income at the bank standalone level. The bank upgraded its consolidated operating profit forecast to ¥100.0 billion from ¥95.0 billion.
